You will work closely with maintenance, engineering, operations, and IT teams to design and configure the Asset Management module in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. What you will do Lead requirements workshops with maintenance, engineering, operations, and IT, map AS-IS processes, and design TO-BE processes. Perform Fit-Gap analyses and recommend solutions using standard Dynamics 365 Asset Management capabilities. Configure Dynamics 365 Asset Management: assets and asset lifecycle, hierarchies, and functional locations asset types and classifications preventive and corrective maintenance, maintenance plans, rounds, and scheduling maintenance requests and work orders counters and condition assessments maintenance resources and workers spare parts and inventory integration maintenance costs and reporting Support time-, usage-, and condition-based preventive maintenance strategies. Ensure functional integration with Inventory Management, Procurement, Production, and Finance. Write functional specifications for integrations, extensions, and customizations. Support migration of asset master data and maintenance history. Run functional, integration, and UAT testing. Deliver documentation and end-user training, and support go-live, hypercare, and stabilization. What we are looking for Proven experience implementing or enhancing the Asset Management module in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management , with strong hands-on configuration. General Dynamics 365 SCM experience alone is not sufficient for this role. Solid knowledge of Enterprise Asset Management and industrial maintenance processes. Understanding of the integration between Asset Management, Inventory Management, and Procurement in Dynamics 365. Experience leading workshops, Fit-Gap analyses, and AS-IS / TO-BE process design. Experience with functional testing, SIT, and UAT. Ability to communicate effectively with maintenance, engineering, operations, and IT teams, and to own functional deliverables independently. Fluent English , written and spoken. Nice to have End-to-end Dynamics 365 Asset Management implementations. Manufacturing, energy, mining, utilities, or other industrial operations. Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, including Inventory, Procurement, and Production Control. EAM integration with shop-floor systems, IoT, sensors, or predictive maintenance. Maintenance KPIs such as MTBF, MTTR, asset availability, and reliability. SAP PM/EAM, IBM Maximo, or similar platforms. ISO 55000 and asset management best practices. Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management certifications.

review_candidates.title: Experienced Mandarin to English Medical Interpreter
review_candidates.description: Company Description LanguagesCX, founded in 2017, specializes in delivering high-quality language services that bridge global communication gaps. The organization focuses on combining strong customer service with a network of highly skilled linguists to support clients worldwide. LanguagesCX serves a diverse international clientele, ensuring that language barriers do not hinder effective communication. Team members contribute to a mission-driven environment that values accuracy, cultural understanding, and professionalism in every interaction. Role Description This full-time remote role is for an Experienced Mandarin to English Medical Interpreter who provides real-time language support between patients, families, and healthcare professionals. Day-to-day responsibilities include performing medical interpretation in clinical, telehealth, and administrative settings, ensuring accurate and culturally appropriate communication. The interpreter will handle both consecutive and simultaneous interpretation, and may support translation of medical documents, patient information, and consent forms. The role also involves maintaining confidentiality, adhering to professional ethics, staying current with medical terminology, and collaborating with care teams to enhance patient understanding and safety. Qualifications Strong medical interpretation skills, including Medical Interpretation and Interpreting in Mandarin to English contexts. Proficiency in Translation and familiarity with Medical Terminology relevant to a wide range of clinical settings. Experience with Simultaneous Interpretation and ability to manage high-pressure, fast-paced medical conversations. Native or near-native fluency in Mandarin and English, with excellent listening, speaking, and comprehension abilities. Prior experience in healthcare, medical interpreting, or related professional settings; certification in medical interpreting is preferred. Ability to work independently in a remote environment, demonstrating reliability, discretion, and adherence to confidentiality standards (e.g., HIPAA or equivalent). Strong interpersonal skills, cultural competence, and the ability to support diverse patients and healthcare teams. Relevant education in languages, translation/interpretation, or healthcare fields is beneficial.
